name: Kenco MCS Chattanooga CH29 - Chattanooga TN

fieldNotes.location: Roster gave an APPROXIMATE geocode for 'Chattanooga, TN 37406' that landed on the CSX DeButts rail classification yard ~5 km west of any Kenco warehouse. Web research resolved Kenco's Chattanooga MCS operations to the Enterprise Park Drive industrial cluster (zip 37416). Kenco Logistic Services has a confirmed building at 6170 Enterprise Park Dr (ROOFTOP geocode 35.0696,-85.1824) and a Kenco affiliate sold a 7-warehouse Chattanooga portfolio in 2022 including a 210,000 SF building near Enterprise South. CH29/CH7B/BP2 are internal Kenco building codes with no public address-to-code mapping, so the specific building for CH29 cannot be verified with certainty.
fieldNotes.buildingChoice: Audited the large ~200x130 m warehouse at 35.0716,-85.1782 in the Enterprise Park Dr cluster as the best fit for CH29 (284,720 SF bulk space) - it is the largest single-tenant warehouse in the immediate cluster with a single dominant dock bank consistent with bulk distribution.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth visible at the property driveway off Enterprise Park Drive. Open paved loop driveway typical of a leased multi-tenant industrial-park warehouse. Medium confidence - the SW dock yard is not fully fenced/controlled in imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~38 dock doors along the SW building face from z18/z19 imagery (regular bay rhythm, several trailers backed in). Band 25-50; low-confidence exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25 trailers staged in the SW apron/yard, including bobtail trailers without tractors; estimate from z18.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide SW apron with substantial unused paved width - room to add a bypass lane if a gate were installed.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Shared SW yard holds parked trailers used for drop storage adjacent to the dock apron.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs through the broader Enterprise Park area but no spur enters this building's parcel.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Chattanooga metro within the Enterprise Park / Enterprise South industrial fabric - Urban.
